name: lucas-tools
description: Claude Code plugins by Lucas Saldanha Werneck: verification guards, session tools, research, web and desktop helpers.

plugins.name: save-clear
plugins.description: Saves decisions and next steps, clears the context, and the next session starts from them.

plugins.name: session-keeper
plugins.description: Restart your Mac, iTerm2 or one Claude Code session without losing windows or conversations.

plugins.name: remote-sessions
plugins.description: Open, resume or fork Claude Code sessions on your computer from your phone.

plugins.name: session-archive
plugins.description: Copies each Claude Code conversation to an archive before Claude Code deletes old ones.

plugins.name: rc-auto
plugins.description: Turns Remote Control on when you type in a desktop-app session, and off after 24 idle hours.

plugins.name: assumptions-pane
plugins.description: A side pane that lists each assumption Claude makes, so you can mark it right or wrong.

plugins.name: idea-shelf
plugins.description: A side pane to park ideas mid-task without stopping Claude, then send them in one click.

plugins.name: plan-checklist
plugins.description: Claude's plan as a checklist in a side pane, ticked off as it works.

plugins.name: clean-view
plugins.description: One switch (/quiet) that hides the tool rows, so you read only the conversation.

plugins.name: side-stack
plugins.description: One side pane where the other side panes stack, instead of one tab each.

plugins.name: give-up-guard
plugins.description: Sends Claude back to check when it ends with "didn't check", gives up, or asks you for data it could find.

plugins.name: wait-loop-guard
plugins.description: Blocks Bash wait loops with no deadline, so Claude can't hang forever.

plugins.name: self-improve
plugins.description: Finds where you corrected Claude more than once and proposes the fix for your OK.

plugins.name: polish
plugins.description: A simplicity review in the style of Linear or Apple Notes: every change with its UX, DX and AX gain, applied only after you pick.

plugins.name: llm-council
plugins.description: Asks several LLMs through OpenRouter; they rank each other's answers and one writes the final answer.

plugins.name: plugin-dev-guard
plugins.description: Stops Claude from editing the installed copy of a plugin and points it to the source repo (or a fork and PR); checks repos against installed copies.

plugins.name: side-notes
plugins.description: Every few steps a side check looks for one thing you may have missed and shows it as a short note above the prompt.

plugins.name: web-unlock
plugins.description: What Claude does when a web fetch is blocked: steps per site type and a record of what worked.

plugins.name: web-unlock-guard
plugins.description: Stops Claude from retrying a blocked site the same way.

plugins.name: op-secrets
plugins.description: Save and load secrets through 1Password without the values entering the chat.

plugins.name: handoff-terminal
plugins.description: A terminal session does the sign-in steps the desktop app refuses.

plugins.name: mac-remote
plugins.description: Lets Claude see and control your Mac through Screen Sharing, even when it is locked.

plugins.name: launchd-agenda
plugins.description: Schedules Claude Code sessions on your Mac with launchd, with your local skills and hooks.

plugins.name: api-credit
plugins.description: Runs claude -p scripts on your plan's monthly API credit first, and on the subscription when the API refuses.
